La carta astral, también llamada <strong: A birth chart, also called a natal chart or astral map, is a picture of the sky at the exact moment you were born, as seen from the place where you were born. It shows which zodiac sign and which house the Sun, the Moon and the planets were in. Astrology uses it as a symbolic map of your personality: your talents, your emotions, the way you love and the challenges you're meant to face.
¿Qué datos necesito y por qué importa la: What information do I need, and why does the time matter?
Necesitas tu fecha, tu hora y tu ciudad: You need your birth date, time and city. The date determines the position of the planets; the time and place determine your rising sign and your houses. The rising sign changes about every two hours, and the houses shift every few minutes, so it's best to use the time on your birth certificate. The tool accounts for the daylight saving time that was in effect in your country on the day you were born.
¿Cómo se lee la rueda?: How do I read the wheel?
<strong>El anillo exterior</strong> mues: The outer ring shows the 12 signs, colored by element: fire, earth, air and water.
<strong>Los números del centro</strong>: The numbers in the center are the 12 houses. The line on the left is your rising sign (AC) and the one at the top is your Midheaven (MC).
<strong>Los símbolos dorados</strong> so: The golden symbols are the planets. An “R” means the planet was retrograde when you were born.
<strong>Las líneas del centro</strong> s: The lines in the center are the aspects: blue for the flowing ones (trines and sextiles) and red for the challenging ones (squares and oppositions).
¿Cuál es la diferencia con el horóscopo?: How is it different from a horoscope?
El <a href=\"horoscopo.html\">horóscopo<: A horoscope only covers your sun sign, the one shared by everyone born in the same month. A birth chart is one of a kind: two people with the same sign have a different Moon, rising sign and houses. That's why many people who don't “feel like” their sign recognize themselves in their Moon or rising sign.
¿Qué necesito para calcular mi carta ast: What do I need to calculate my birth chart?
Tu fecha de nacimiento, la hora lo más e: Your birth date, your birth time as precisely as possible, and the city where you were born. With those three details, we calculate the position of the Sun, Moon and planets, your rising sign and your 12 houses.
¿Qué pasa si no sé mi hora de nacimiento: What if I don't know my birth time?
Puedes marcar “No sé la hora”. Verás tu: You can check “I don't know my birth time.” You'll see your Sun, Moon and planets in their signs, but not your rising sign or houses, because those change every few minutes. Your birth time is usually listed on your birth certificate.
Las posiciones se calculan con fórmulas: Positions are calculated with high-precision astronomical formulas. We compare them against the Swiss Ephemeris, which professional software uses, and the difference is less than one arcminute.

Usa el sistema Placidus, el más habitual: It uses the Placidus system, the most common in Western astrology, and the tropical zodiac. If you were born near the poles, where Placidus doesn't work, it switches to the Porphyry system.

¿Por qué necesito la hora exacta?: Why do I need my exact birth time?
Por el giro de la Tierra, los doce signo: Because of the Earth's rotation, all twelve signs cross the horizon in one day, so your rising sign changes roughly every two hours. A difference of just a few minutes can change it if you were born near a sign change, which is why the calculator warns you when your rising sign falls in its first or last degrees.
Cada signo tiene un planeta que lo “gobi: Each sign has a planet that “rules” it: Mars for Aries, Venus for Taurus and Libra, Mercury for Gemini and Virgo, and so on. The ruler of your rising sign is the ruler of your whole chart, and the house it sits in shows where a good part of your energy is headed.
